family: One fixed total language L with slices on all bit lengths N. If N<4 reject. Otherwise choose the largest integer w>=1 with n_w=2*w*2^w<=N, partition the first n_w bits into 2^w consecutive records of 2w bits, and accept iff these records are pairwise distinct; ignore the remaining N-n_w bits. A fixed deterministic polynomial-time pairwise-comparison evaluator decides L. Its NP verifier accepts exactly the empty witness when this evaluator accepts, with witness bound zero.
theorem: Fix R=10^256-1. For the fixed language L in P defined here, there exists N0 such that C_B2(L_N)>=R*N*(log2(log2 N))^R for EVERY integer N>=N0, with empty remainder. For each real A>0 there is N_A such that C_B2(L_N)>=A*N for every integer N>=N_A. These unconditional statements use the supplied distinctness tensor theorem over F_2, full-B2 conversion and all-length padding. Its exponent sigma>0 is fixed but not numerical.
